postClients.name: SANSU International Campus
postClients.summary: SANSU International Campus is a higher-education institute in Kandy, Sri Lanka, operating since 2015. It offers diploma programmes and certificate courses, along with pathways to study overseas and corporate training.
services: Social media post design for the campus's certificate programmes
A creative concept for every course, told as a before-and-after story
Bilingual (Sinhala and English) post layouts with the campus branding
objectives: Promote the certificate programmes in psychology, counselling and education
Encourage enquiries and enrolments through a clear "Enrol now" and website call to action
Keep a consistent, recognisable look across a 12-post series

postClients.name: Fairplays Online
postClients.summary: Fairplays is an online sports-betting and casino platform. Its own site offers a sportsbook, live casino and other games through a wallet-based account, with customer support, and is available in several languages including English and Hindi.
services: Social media post design
Match-day and fixture announcement creatives for major cricket games
Themed sports artwork in English and Hindi (cricket, table tennis, badminton, virtual league)
Instagram content for the brand's social presence
Search engine optimisation (SEO) for the website
objectives: Keep the brand visible around major cricket fixtures
Reach both English- and Hindi-speaking audiences
Carry the brand's service and support messages in every post

postClients.name: Lanka Holidays
postClients.summary: Lanka Holidays is a Colombo-based travel company that has designed privately guided journeys across Sri Lanka since 2005. Trips combine hand-picked hotels, cultural and wildlife experiences and in-country coordination, with optional extras such as private transfers and yacht charters.
services: Social media post design
Destination-led post concepts: hill country, wildlife, culture and the north
Instagram content for the brand's social presence
objectives: Show Sri Lanka's experiences, from mountain views to safaris and ancient sites, in a premium, visual way
Turn interest into enquiries with clear calls to action such as requesting a guide or booking an early-morning pass
Keep one consistent look across every destination story

postClients.name: TMR Bikes
postClients.summary: TMR Trading Lanka (Pvt) Ltd sells electric bikes and scooters under the TMR (True Man Racing) brand from Yakkala, in the Gampaha District. It also sells solar panels and accessories, and announces new dealers in towns such as Mahaoya and Kattankudy.
services: Social media post design
Model launch creatives for the COLA 5 and G18, with prices and a Book a Test Ride call to action
Dealer-opening announcement posts for new showrooms
Occasion posts, such as Children's Day and Elders' Day
Facebook page content
objectives: Launch new scooter models with clear prices and a test-ride call to action
Tell customers where to see and buy the bikes as new dealers open
Show the scooters in everyday family use

postClients.name: Apex Industries
postClients.summary: Apex Industries is a Colombo-based manufacturer and importer of disposable products: eco-friendly cutlery, kraft food boxes, bamboo BBQ sticks and coffee cups, with custom logo printing available for business customers.
services: Product-focused social media post design
Eco-friendly and food-safe messaging built into each creative
A consistent branded footer with contact details across the series
objectives: Present the range (cutlery, boxes, BBQ sticks and cups) in a clean, appetising way
Promote the eco-friendly, food-grade positioning
Highlight custom logo printing to win business customers

postClients.name: Serendib News
postClients.summary: Serendib News is an online news network serving Sri Lanka and the wider South Asian community. It publishes in English, Sinhala and Tamil, with editions for Sri Lanka, India, Australia and the UAE.
services: Social media post design in Sinhala, Tamil and English
Facebook page content
Search engine optimisation (SEO) for serendibnews.net
objectives: Present Serendib News as a trusted news source in all three languages
Invite organisers to share their events and news with a global audience
Show the network's reach: three languages across four countries

postClients.name: NGM Motors
postClients.summary: NGM, short for New Genuine Motors, is a motorcycle workshop in Welisara, near Ragama in the Gampaha District. Its Facebook page describes it as a certified Bajaj service centre, and it repairs and services motorcycles and sells spare parts.
services: Recruitment ad design for four roles: mechanics, bike washers, office assistants and spare-parts assistants
A repeatable Sinhala "We're hiring" template with a WhatsApp number to apply
Facebook page content
objectives: Attract applicants for open roles across the workshop, the parts counter and the office
Make applying simple, with the age requirement and a WhatsApp number on every ad
Show each role in action so applicants know what the job involves

postClients.name: RM Traders
postClients.summary: RM Traders (Pvt) Ltd is an authorised Honda motorcycle dealer in the Gampaha and Puttalam districts, with branches in Kochchikade, Negombo, Wennappuwa and Marawila. Its posts also promote Honda spare parts and servicing.
services: Social media post design
Offer-led creatives, such as down payments starting from Rs. 215,000
Spare-parts and servicing campaign posts
A branch contact footer covering all four locations
objectives: Bring customers in with clear starting prices and a call-now action
Position RM Traders as a one-stop shop for bikes and spare parts
Make every branch easy to reach, with contact details on every post

postClients.name: Upaliee Transworks
postClients.summary: Upaliee Transworks Services is a prime-mover and container transport company based in Ja-Ela, Sri Lanka. It moves import and export cargo between the Port of Colombo and warehouses, factories and depots across the island, and keeps its fleet running from its own workshop.
services: Website design and development
Social media post design
Facebook page content
objectives: Show the size of the fleet and its island-wide reach for large projects
Keep the navy-and-yellow branding consistent across the website and social media

postClients.name: eSupport
postClients.summary: eSupport Technologies is a digital marketing and technology company headquartered in Colombo, Sri Lanka, with offices in Dubai and Australia. It builds websites and ERP systems and runs digital marketing, SEO and design for its clients.
services: In-house post design for our web development, ERP and digital marketing services
Concept-led creatives that explain each service with a single visual idea
Recruitment posts for open roles such as Business Analyst intern and Graphic Designer
objectives: Explain our services in a simple, memorable way
Generate enquiries with a consistent contact and website footer
Attract new team members through hiring posts

jobs.title: Senior Full-Stack Engineer (Next.js & Laravel)
jobs.description: Lead the development of custom client web applications, complex ERP systems, and high-performance digital platforms.
jobs.responsibilities:
• Architect and build responsive Next.js / React frontends and scalable Laravel APIs.
• Optimize application performance, SEO, accessibility, and database queries.
• Review peer pull requests and mentor junior engineers.
• Collaborate directly with designers and project stakeholders.
jobs.requirements:
• Strong proficiency in TypeScript, React / Next.js, PHP, and modern Laravel.
• Experience with relational databases (MySQL, PostgreSQL) and RESTful API design.
• Familiarity with modern CSS frameworks (TailwindCSS) and version control (Git).
• Excellent problem-solving and English communication skills.

jobs.title: UI/UX & Product Designer
jobs.description: Design sleek, intuitive user interfaces and unforgettable digital journeys for international brands and bespoke enterprise platforms.
jobs.responsibilities:
• Craft wireframes, user flows, and high-fidelity interactive prototypes in Figma.
• Build and maintain modular design systems and component libraries.
• Collaborate with front-end engineers to ensure flawless visual execution.
• Conduct usability testing and iterate based on client feedback and analytics.
jobs.requirements:
• Strong portfolio showcasing web and mobile interface designs.
• Mastery of Figma, modern typography, grid systems, and micro-animations.
• Understanding of front-end capabilities and design constraints.
• Keen eye for luxury, minimalism, and modern interactive aesthetics.

jobs.title: Digital Marketing & Performance Strategist
jobs.description: Drive exponential growth for our clients through data-driven performance marketing, SEO, and paid multi-channel ad campaigns.
jobs.responsibilities:
• Plan and execute Meta Ads, Google Search & Display, and LinkedIn campaigns.
• Formulate organic SEO strategies and technical audits for client websites.
• Analyze campaign KPIs, CAC, and ROAS, delivering actionable monthly client reports.
• Brainstorm viral social media concepts and creative campaign angles.
jobs.requirements:
• Proven track record managing profitable paid media campaigns.
• Proficiency with Google Analytics 4, Meta Ads Manager, and SEO tools (Ahrefs / SEMrush).
• Strong copy-ideation skills and data analytical mindset.
• Experience with client communication and presenting insights.

jobs.title: Business Analyst / Project Intern
jobs.description: Join our product delivery team to bridge client requirements with engineering execution. Ideal for ambitious graduates seeking rapid industry immersion.
jobs.responsibilities:
• Gather and document software requirements, user stories, and feature specs.
• Coordinate between client stakeholders and development teams.
• Assist with quality assurance (QA) and acceptance testing before client launches.
• Participate in agile sprints, daily standups, and project roadmap reviews.
jobs.requirements:
• Degree or ongoing studies in IT, Software Engineering, Business Information Systems, or related field.
• High analytical thinking, detail orientation, and fast learning speed.
• Good verbal and written communication in English.
• Enthusiasm for modern tech products and startup culture.

jobs.title: Creative Graphic Designer & Motion Artist
jobs.description: Produce captivating social media post designs, brand identity assets, short-form motion reels, and client campaign visuals.
jobs.responsibilities:
• Design high-converting social media posts and banners for brand clients.
• Create short-form video reels, animations, and kinetic typography.
• Ensure visual consistency with brand guidelines across all deliverables.
• Turn marketing concepts into thumb-stopping visual artwork.
jobs.requirements:
• Proficiency in Photoshop, Illustrator, and Premiere Pro / After Effects.
• Portfolio of commercial post designs, brand visuals, or motion reels.
• Creativity, speed, and receptiveness to feedback.
• Strong passion for visual storytelling and digital trends.
